text: Dee-Kur is an Argonian female that can be found in the Halls of Fabrication.
Deesh-Mota is an Argonian slave that can be found in the entrace to the Halls of Fabrication. He is standing next to Egg-Face and cannot be spoken to.
Deetum-Gih is an Argonian sailor of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village. He has no unique dialogue.
Deed-Tei is an Argonian member of the Moss-Skin Tribe residing in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Deemat is an Argonian farmer residing at Lilmoth. She has no unique dialogue.
Deckhand Bazler is a Breton sailor encountered shivering in the snowy mountainside surrounding Folgunthur Barrow in .

Dibella, called Dibe by the Kothringi, is the goddess of beauty, love, art and music, and is one of the Nine Divines. In Cyrodiil, she has nearly a dozen different cults, some devoted to women, some to artists and aesthetics, and some even to erotic instruction.

Delfran was a bandit leader that terrorized the Azra's Crossing area. He managed to capture the Imperial fugitive, Skelos Undriel. He later raided Azra's Crossing, and captured most of the villagers. The mysterious Hero of Azra's Crossing managed to defeat and destroy Delfran's gang. Delfran had a Shadowkey in his possession, found on his throne in Delfran's Hideout.

Delte Fyr is a Dunmer who resides in Tel Fyr. She is one of the four "daughters" of Divayth Fyr. She was created by Divayth as a "side benefit of the researches into corprus disease." Delte now exists solely to serve her master/father, Divayth, and takes care of the family's accounts and finances. Her "sisters" are Alfe, Beyte, and Uupse.
Dethresa Saren is a layman member of the Tribunal who resides at the Molag Mar Temple in Morrowind. He is a nondescript Dunmer Monk who does not offer any services and is not involved in any quests.

Dilami Androm is a Dunmer caravaner who operates the Silt Strider service in Molag Mar. Dilami can be found at her post northwest of town waiting for customers. She wears common clothing and is unarmed. As with all other caravaners, raising her disposition will lead to better travel fares. Dilami is not involved in any quests.
Dervera Romalen is a Dunmer publican, owner of the Newlands Lodge in Cheydinhal. She rents beds for 10 and has 50 available for bartering.
Denel is an Imperial mage and a member of the Mages Guild. He works for Skaleel in the excavation project in Vahtacen.
Demetrius is a Redguard who is a devoted worshipper of the Daedric Prince Meridia. He often spends day and night worshipping at the shrine.
Dengeir of Stuhn is a Nord who is the former Jarl of Falkreath, and is currently a thane of the Hold. He will retake his former position as Jarl if the Stormcloaks claim Falkreath.
Dervenin is a Bosmer servant of the Daedric Prince Sheogorath, who refers to him as "luggage."
Desideratus Annius was an Imperial warrior who resided in the Shivering Isles in the ruined city of Vitharn.
Deldasa Thirandus is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton.
Delmene Helas is a Dunmer pilgrim and member of the Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Hall of Wisdom beneath Vivec, Temple Canton.
Delmus Rurvyn is a Dunmer pauper who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
Delyna Mandas is a Dunmer Agent in . She is the daughter of Arethan Mandas. She can be encountered in Tel Fyr, either through random exploration or as the object of a quest to rescue her.

Derar Hlervu is a Dunmer witch and worshipper of Molag Bal living near his shrine inside Bal Ur. She can be found standing under the large statue of Molag Bal, in the underground. She can give the Nerevarine advice on curing vampirism.
Deras Girando is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton in the waistworks.

Deval Beleth is a Dunmer pilgrim residing in the city of Ald'ruhn. Deval works for House Redoran as a blacksmith. Devals mother, Tuveso Beleth, is also a smith, and runs a shop that is located in Redoran Council Hall.

Dhaunayne Aundae is an Altmer nightblade and the leader of the Clan Aundae Vampires. To join the Aundae, the Nerevarine must be infected with Porphyric hemophilia by a member of the clan. Once the Nerevarine has joined the Aundae, Dhaunayne will provide quests that will strengthen the clan as well as allow the Nereverine the services that clan members are afforded.
Dexion Evicus is an Imperial Moth Priest who is traveling across Skyrim in search of an Elder Scroll to add to his order's collection.
Devir-Mir was a heretic who was considered too dangerous to be held in a prison in a "civilized" province. After he was convicted, he was sent to a prison in the Imperial province of Black Marsh.
The Desperate Gambler is a Nord contractor for the quest "The Dark Brotherhood Forever." He resides in the Windhelm Barracks in the Palace of the Kings.
Deldrise Andoren is a Dunmer noble who lives in Andoren Manor with her husband Taren Andoren in the district of Godsreach, Mournhold.
Denegor is a Bosmer commoner who resides inside the The Winged Guar inn, in the district of Godsreach, Mournhold.
Detritus Caria is a Breton noble who can be found in the Craftsmen's Hall in Godsreach. He wants the Nerevarine to help him find various items to complete his collection.

Denskar Earth-Turner is a Nord chef residing in Bleakrock Village, along with his wife, Aera, and his two kids, Trynhild and Littrek. He is forced to leave the island with the rest of the residents and relocate to Bal Foyen after the village is ransacked by Daggerfall Covenant forces.
Deregor is a Bosmer residing in Saintsport, Stros M'Kai. He is Crafty Lerisa's first mate and when first met he has been captured by the Sea Drakes.
Denyse Emax is a Breton residing in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She is typically found praying or sitting in the Daggerfall Cathedral.
Deputy Luric is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. He is found down by the docks.
Deryvyra Bienena is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle found at her stables, where she sells horses.
Desuuga the Siren is a Nereid world boss residing in the Siren's Cove.
Derami Heryon is a Dunmer smith found in the Plaza of the Gods in Mournhold. She is located directly before the steps leading up to the forge facing the Wayshrine, sweeping the floor.

Devron is the leader of the Blue Raiders in Raider's Nest, and a character in . He is in constant conflict with the Red and Gold Raiders. He is found in the blue section of Raider's Nest, in the west.
Delacroix is a Breton, and one of four champions of Governor Vinticae. Although working for him, Delacroix expresses a lot of distrust toward the Governor.
Desyree Bargeron is a Breton residing in the city of Evermore.
Denu Faren is a Dunmer of House Dres. She resides inside the Grandmaster's Palace in Kragenmoor.
Diendus Verethi is a Dunmer found inside the instruction halls of Shad Astula.
Delkash is a Redguard member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea.
Deldwine Antler-Fur is a Nord brewer and owner of Deldwine's Inn in Fort Amol, Eastmarch. She is married to Holvur Antler-Fur.
Delves-Deeply is an Argonian researcher trapped in the ruins of Quendeluun.
Demeepa is an Argonian magus of the Mages Guild residing at the Guild Hall in the city of Vulkhel Guard.
Demis is a Dremora part of the invasion force who took over Dawnbreak. They have a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Dennoroth is a Bosmer outlaw who can be found at the outlaws refuge beneath the city of Marbruk.
Deowyn is a Nord weaponsmith. She sells her wares at her stall, Something Sharp, at the marketplace in Riften.
Deputy Ascenge is a Breton member of the Hoarfrost Downs town guard.
Deputy Dorianne Rohde is a Breton member of the Wind Keep Town Guard.
Deroh-Metaku is a worshipper of Sanguine found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Deros is a Bosmer shipmaster preventing Captain Khammo access to Anvil.
Desha is a Kothringi scout found just outside Stillrise Village.
Destane the Bard is a Breton bard playing for the guests attending to the party at the At-Tura Estate.
Dethrel is a Kothringi spirit being interrogated by Dominion soldiers in the ruins of Zuuk.
Detu-Meeus is an Argonian found in Stormhold. She can be found in the Ayleid ruins southwest of the town, sitting with her pet mouse, Meht, who is feeling ill from a recent meal.
Dezanu is an Argonian worshipper of Sanguine found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Dh'andsa is the Redguard lieutenant of the Ra Gada on the docks of Velyn Harbor.
Dhalen is a Breton illusionist hired by the Stormfist Clan to assassinate High King Jorunn during the meeting with his War Council in Fort Amol.
Dianne Luric is a Breton patron of the Sundry Swills in Alten Corimont.
Dias is a Dremora found in Torinaan, where he is corrupting various sacred shrines. They have a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Didrika is a Nord tailor. She sells her wares at her stall, Didrika's Loom, at the trading hall in Bleakrock Village.
Dihoq is a Redguard brewer member of the The Crowns working at the Stone Oasis Inn in Bergama.

, a Demiprince.]] A Demiprince is the offspring of a Daedric Prince or Daedra Lord and a lesser entity, such as a mortal. While they inherit aspects of their Daedric parent, they are notably eccentric and lack basic characteristics such as foresight, memory, cruelty, or willfulness. Some are given, or acquire, minor pocket realms of Oblivion to rule over. These realms are often considered "bizarre" or "eccentric," even by Oblivion's standards. Some demiprinces are known to occasionally visit Mundus for the express purpose of interacting with mortals.
Dhemireh is a Redguard residing in Woodhearth inside Pharad's Home.
Dhemeeta is a Redguard residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Dergla is an Argonian residing in the city Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Delmus Ulvel is a Dunmer residing in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Deverak Arnese is a Breton residing in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Delvin Etelette is a Breton found in Delvin's House in Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Dersaja is a Redguard found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. She cannot be interacted with.
Dhanim is a Khajiit found sweeping the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Derveglor is a Bosmer laborer residing in the Dockyards in the city of Davon's Watch.
Devourer is a class of enemy character residing in . There are several different instances of this character that exist in , belonging to different factions and regions.

Denille Derre is a Breton commoner found in Koeglin Village. She can be found walking around the Guild Traders. She is a potential assassination target in the region of Stormhaven. She has no unique dialogue.
Deputy Charmax is a Breton member of the Koeglin Town Guard. He can by found by the entrance to the Docks Warehouse.
Deputy Surges is a Breton member of the Koeglin Town Guard. He can be found running back and forth along the docks.
Delos Thimalvel is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu. He resides inside his kinhouse in Narsis.
Devas Seri is a Dunmer found in Iliath Temple. He has no unique dialogue.
Delvoni Hlaalu is a Dunmer Noble, and member of House Hlaalu walking between Pilgrim's Market and the Vivec City Wayshrine in Vivec City. He cannot be interacted with, and has no unique dialogue.

Deminah Salvi or Governor Salvi is a Dunmer residing in Seyda Neen on Vvardenfell, and deputy governor of Seyda Neen. If "Broken Bonds" is completed, she will already be governor. If not, she becomes governor at the conclusion of "Breaking Through the Fog."
Dervera is a Dunmer thief found in the Saint Olms Waistworks on the upper level of the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.
Deldasa is a Dunmer commoner residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. She is located inside The Rested Kwama tavern. She has no unique dialogue.
Dexion Berne is a character residing in Galom Daeus, in Vvardenfell. They are a Vampire, and a member of the Berne Clan.
Delte Nethri is a Dunmer residing in Balmora. She is a Hall Steward of the Fighters Guild.
Destaine Stegine is a Breton residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. Since the disturbance in the Gnisis Egg Mine, his workplace, he remains trapped in the mine.
Dest is a character who appears in . He was an Umbrielian working in Qijne's kitchen.
Dervera Velni is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Dexion Casca is an Imperial member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Dholia is a Redguard priest of Tu'whacca held hostage by the Withered Hand at Tu'whacca's Throne.
Dessicated Archers are generic characters encountered during the quest "The Mind Trap." They have no unique dialogue.

Deyanira Katrece, also known as The Lesser Nocturnal, is a Daedra encountered in Shade Perilous. In order to free the Greater Nocturnal from her slumber, Deyanira must be banished. Deyanira does not regret the situation, instead encouraging the Apprentice to strike "with all thy arm and heart," for her love of her mistress appears to outshine all consequences.
Derkeehez is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village.
Desh-Jasaiin is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village.
Destane is a Breton in the Town. He is the brother of Gabrielle Larouche.
Delida the Damned is a Draugr encountered inside Midnight Barrow, Greymoor Caverns, in .
Derana Rothalen is a hostile Dunmer encountered outside Balmora. She is a member of Othloth Salavel's gang.
Divad Hunding was an early Yokudan–Redguard hero. In Hammerfell, there is even a holiday in honor of him, the Divad Etep't. He is also referenced in the book Divad the Singer.

Divayth Fyr is a 4000-year-old Dunmer sorcerer who is the caretaker of the Corprusarium. He can be found at the top of the Tel Fyr tower, where he lives with his four "daughters," who refer to themselves as his "wives"; Alfe, Beyte, Delte, and Uupse. It is later revealed that they are in fact female clones of himself. He is a member of Great House Telvanni, though he generally stays out of House politics. Although he is the oldest and one of the most respected members of the House, he is not a member of the Council, and has no intention of joining.
Dinok is a Redguard miner from the Shulk Egg Mine in Morrowind. He is seen during the "Egg Poachers" quest.
Dion is an Imperial and the Captain of the guard in Skingrad. If he is not standing guard outside the Great Chapel of Julianos, he can be found patrolling the streets.

Diram Serethi is a Dunmer, living in Aleswell with his two sisters, Urnsi Serethi and Adosi Serethi. When the Hero arrives in Aleswell, he is the one approaching and asking for help with the invisibility spell caused by Ancotar.
Dirge is a gruff Imperial associate of the Thieves Guild in Riften. His brother Maul is Maven Black-Briar's right-hand man.
Dinya Balu is a Dunmer priestess in who resides in the Temple of Mara in Riften.
Direr Arano is a Dunmer member of House Hlaalu residing at the Arano Plantation.

Dileno Lloran is a Dunmer disciple of the Tribunal Temple. She resides at High Fane, in Vivec City's Temple Canton. Dileno is a priestess and an assistant to the Archcanon, Tholer Saryoni. She also offers services to Temple members ranked Acolyte or higher.
Dils Heladren is a Dunmer knight residing in the cave of Zaintirari. He is hostile towards the Nerevarine, and will attack on sight.
Dilvene Venim is a Dunmer noble and Kinsmen of House Redoran, who resides in Venim Manor in Ald'ruhn during . She is the wife of Bolvyn Venim and can be found in her bedroom.
Dinor Thilandas is Dunmer Thief and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. He can be found on the lower level and is hostile.
Dinuro Ienith is a Dunmer priest, and worshipper of Molag Bal residing in Bal Ur. She is found outside the shrine.
Dirara Drom is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind in Dirara's Farmhouse.
Diren Vendu is a Dunmer Sorcerer who resides in Tel Mora. She will sell spells to the Nerevarine. She also provides spellmaking services.
Dissu Ashalkimallit is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in the Ashlands of Vvardenfell.
Dolmesa Sarano is a Dunmer Battlemage residing in Halit Mine.
Dolsa Gilvani is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
Diseased Cliff Racer is a creature in . They are a variation of Cliff Racer. Helljoint may be contracted from this creature.
Dirding is a Bosmer Sorcerer who resides in the cave of Aharnabi.
Diradeni Farano is a Dunmer guard located in the Throne Room of the Royal Palace, Mournhold. She is a member of the Royal Guard and wears a full set of Royal Guard Armor.
Domalen is a Redguard Commoner who resides in the Foreign Quarter Plaza in Vivec City.

Domba is an armored Redguard witch who can be encountered in the right wing of Ald Daedroth in the Azura's Coast region. She is accompanied by Gnaw Tooth at the Daedric shrine to Lord Sheogorath, located on an island east of Mzuleft, and northeast of the Rotheran Stronghold. Domba is hostile towards the Nerevarine and will readily engage in combat with any adversary in sight.
Dithisi Girvu is a Dunmer merchant who can be found at Eidolon's Hollow in the region of Deshaan. She is accompanied by her guard, Roneril the Mercenary.
Distel is a Bosmer archer, and a member of House Telvanni residing in lower level of Shishara in the Ashlands of Morrowind.
Dirwendel is a Bosmer found in Eagle's Strand. She can be found to the left of the exit to Khenarthi's Roost, talking to Edhelfin.
Diranor is a Bosmer who resides in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard.
Dirty Delric is a Breton residing in Port Hunding. He can be found in the Screaming Mermaid.
Dissident Warrior is a Bosmer member of the Dissidents residing at The Middens, Elden Root.

Dinieras-Ves, nicknamed "the Iron," was a Tsaesci. He founded the Syffim, an organization of former Akaviri warriors. This would later become known as the Fighters Guild, after the introduction of the Guilds Act.
Dithis Romori is a Dunmer mage and the brother of Denthis Romori.
Disciple Sildras is Dunmer servant of the Tribunal Temple in Ebonheart. He can be found kneeling in front of the shrine, praying to the Tribunal.
Dilborn is a Breton mage who is currently held captive by a gang in the Residential Sewers of Old Mournhold, beneath the district of Godsreach in Mournhold.
Doldoniel is the Bosmer inkeeper of The Waxing Crescent, in the city of Rawl'kha.
Dimi is a cat who can be found at the Riverside Inn in Nimalten.
Dimarra is a Khajiit found onboard The Blasted Breton in Alten Corimont.

Dinmar af-Islah is a member of Captain Currod's crew. He can be found injured, lying on the deck of The Tava's Bounty. After the completion of the quest "False Accusations," he will be receiving treatment from Belya Surges. He has no unique dialogue.
Dinwenel is a member of the Vinedusk Rangers in who guards the gates of Hectahame.
Dirilu is a Dunmer fisher found at the Bal Foyen Dockyards. She has no unique dialogue.
Dirsherr is a Khajiit shepherd found west of the Temple of the Mourning Springs.
Disciple Cesamund is a Breton member of the Rain Disciples found in the ruins of Bisnensel. He was captured by Primeval Seekers who tried to return his memories.
Disciple Dianette is a Breton member of the Rain Disciples found in the ruins of Bisnensel. She was captured by Primeval Seekers who tried to return her memories.
Disciple Jeannelle is a Breton member of the Rain Disciples found in the ruins of Bisnensel. She was captured by Primeval Seekers who tried to return her memories.
Disciple Theophile is a member of the Rain Disciples found in the ruins of Bisnensel. He was captured by Primeval Seekers who tried to return his memories.
Dockmaster Bahir is the Redguard overseer of the Sentinel Docks.
Dog-Bite-Me is a Khajiit residing at the Temple of Two-Moons Dance.
Dorlirdor is a Bomser worshipper of Baan Dar. She may be found in the ruins of Thormar.
Dolril Belvayn is a Dunmer monk found in the monastery of Muth Gnaar.
Domi Hlaalu is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu. She resides inside the Sadri House in Narsis.
Domia is a Redguard laborer found moving barrels across Port Hunding. She has no unique dialogue.
Dogas the Berserker is a powerful Dremora found in Crypt of Hearts I in the Rivenspire region of High Rock. He has a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Dogsbody Jac of the Ungodly is a Dunmer member of The Ungodly found at their camp at Sep's Spine.
Dindom is a Bosmer found eating near a campfire in Morkuldin Haven, sharing it with Tikkus and Sayla Daren.
Dombuza is a Redguard bard found in the Hubalajad Palace in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. She is impossible to interact with.
Dockmaster Qamar is a Redguard dockmaster and member of the Red Sails found in Anvil. He in in charge of taxing the ships coming into Anvil's harbor.
Dils Romari is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact residing in the town of Davon's Watch, Stonefalls. He has no unique dialogue.
Dinuro Malas is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found in Davon's Watch. She has no unique dialogue.
Dolphins are passive aquatic creatures in . They can be encountered in few shallow bodies of water, and jump out from the water shortly before diving back in.
Dolian is a Bosmer chef and a member of the Falinesti Faithful. She is found at the Falinesti Autumn Site.
Direfrost Stormamster is a skeleton that appears in . It is a Skeleton found in the group dungeon, Direfrost Keep.
Dishonored Skald is a Nord contractor in who resides in the Bards College in Solitude.
Dollarthor is a Bosmer mage of the Mages Guild residing outside the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City. He offers no unique dialogue.
Div Nervion is a Dunmer general goods merchant working at the St. Olms Market in the Saint Olms Plaza on the upper level of the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City.
Dinor Salvi is a Dunmer residing in the Saint Olms Waistworks in the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City.
Dilven Andrani is a character residing in Vivec City, in Vvardenfell.
Dinya Velendas is a Dunmer scholar and member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. She does not have any unique dialogue.
Dokishnaza is an Argonian member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.

Domihaus the Bloody-Horned is the final boss that appears in the Falkreath Hold dungeon in . Domihaus is one of the two leaders of the Dreadhorn Clan, an alliance of Reachmen and Minotaurs that invaded the city of Falkreath. He is the final boss of the Falkreath Hold group dungeon.
Dogeater Witch is a goblin in that is a member of the Dogeater Tribe. They can be found at the Dogeater Goblin Camp on Stros M'Kai.
Dogeater Skirmisher is a goblin in that is a member of the Dogeater Tribe.
Dogeater Butcher is a goblin in that is a member of the Dogeater Tribe. They can be found at the Dogeater Goblin Camp on Stros M'Kai.
Dobias Sophus is an Imperial trader of the Gold Coast Trading Company, residing in Kvatch and found wandering the Traders' Circle.
Dohraq af-Rasha is a Redguard who is part of the gang of profiteers at the Crossroads Encampment.
Dinahan-Al-Rihad is a Redguard prince of Rihad, who is in exile in the Third Empire. He is under asylum in Cyrodiil and is planning on retaking the city of Rihad from the Aldmeri Dominion.
Dilmus Bavani is a Dunmer residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell. He can be seen talking to Tumsa Vavas across the road from Lord Drono's Townhouse. He cannot be interacted with.

Dominus is the Breton master of the Dragonstar Fighters Guild in . When he is not in the guild hall, he is out killing Skyrim interlopers. For a fee, he will enlist recruits wishing to join the Guild.
Dondos Driler is a Dunmer Noble in Balmora. He is also a member of House Hlaalu.
Dorynu Verendas is a Dunmer living in the Redoran Stronghold of Marandus. She is a member of House Redoran.

Dovyn Aren is an ex-member of the Thieves Guild. Dovyn spends his days walking around the Imperial City or wandering through the city's sewers. His house is located in the northeastern section of the Elven Gardens District, right next to Ida Vlinorman's house, it has two stories with the upper being his personal living quarters. He carries a steel longsword and wears a leather cuirass and boots along with burgundy linens.
Dorian is a Redguard commoner who lives in the Imperial City, Talos Plaza District.
Dovesi Dran is a Dunmer commoner in that can be encountered in the house of Summitmist Manor in Skingrad.
Dorthe is a Nord child. She is the young cousin of Hadvar and daughter of Sigrid and Alvor the blacksmith, who both live in Riverwood.
Dothasi Mothryon is a Dunmer rogue and smuggler, and resides in the bandit-inhabited cave of Nund.
Dovres Verethi is a Dunmer smuggler who resides in the cave of Mannammu. He is the leader of the Verethi Gang of bandits.
Dovrosi Varyon is Dunmer Rogue and smuggler who resides in the cave of Shurinbaal in the Bitter Coast.
Dortodd is a hostile Redguard healer and Daedra worshipper who resides at the Daedric shrine Addadshashanammu.
Dothruviel is a Bosmer Barbarian and slaver residing in the bottom level of the stronghold of Hlormaren.
Donus Serethi is a Dunmer spellsword who resides inside Llethan Manor in the district of Godsreach, Mournhold. He is a servant of Ravani Llethan, King Athyn Llethan's widow.

Dorald Larich was the second born son to King Mhorus of Skingrad, he was rather simple-minded and was a priest of Marukh before becoming King of Skingrad. After King Mhorus' death in 1E 478 his son, Dorald became King of Skingrad and in turn ceded his Kingdom to the Alessian Empire. This action enraged and shocked many of the other Kingdoms within the Colovian Estates and led to his murder and usurpation of his throne by his own brother Rislav Larich during the Coup at Skingrad.

Lady Doryanna Flyte is the wife of Auberon Flyte, the ruler of Anticlere, a fiefdom in the Iliac Bay. Although her husband is the formal ruler of the city and region, it is Lady Flyte who controls all political matters in both. She and her husband are the lieges of Anticlere's knightly order, the Knights of the Flame.
Dondir is a Bosmer Thief residing in Beshara. Dondir along with Alvur Hleran have angered Tinos Drothan, a former employer whom they stole from.
Drago Auberdine is a Breton who resides in Betnikh. He is one of the characters found in King Renwic's vision.
Doom Witch Dekamma is a Dremora bound by the Oathbound Clan found within the Obsidian Scar. They have a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Doralin is a Bosmer found in her house in Longhaven, Greenshade.
Dorodir is a Bosmer residing in Headman Bhosek's palace. He thinks the Vestige is one of the servants as they are wearing a servant's disguise when entering the palace.
Dorothique is a Breton residing in Bad Man's Hallows, Glenumbra. She is found praying near the large tree.
Dongenan is a Bosmer residing in Bramblebreach in the Greenshade region.

Doriel is a Bosmer alchemist in Bramblebreach. She spends most of her time wandering around the city controlling and fixing the artificial structures she herself has built there. She is also looking after the tribe's oldest member, Elengil.

Donriel is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, in the region of Greenshade. She can also be found in the Western Warehouse at the Sentinel Docks after the quest "Risen from the Depths." She has no unique dialogue.
Donnaelain is a Bosmer Guild Trader residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth.
Dorys Barthel is a Breton weaponsmith residing in the city of Evermore.
Dorinlas is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea.
Dominique Dantien is a Breton moneylender and part of the group of outlaws found beneath Marbruk.
Dondrothel is the innkeeper of The Greenbower in Woodhearth.
Doradrin the Dark is a Bosmer competing in The Summoner Division at the Thizzrini Arena.
Doralineth is a Bosmer drunkard in who is found in Vulkhel Guard.
Dordanion is a Bosmer armorer residing at the Baandari Trading Post in Malabal Tor. He can be found at his store The Defender's Domain, selling his wares.
Doril Randoro is a Dunmer ghost found in the House Dres Crypts in Kragenmoor.
Dorothella Eriel is a Breton patron of The Sloshing Tankard in Northpoint.
Dosa is an Argonian guild trader selling her wares at the Windswept Stalls in Windhelm.
Dowoseez is an Argonian laborer found in Windhelm, Eastmarch. He is one of the celebrants of the Konunleikar.
Dracien Montue is a Breton member of the Mages Guild, who is part of the group trying to stop Canonreeve Oraneth's ritual.

Donus Falto is an Imperial found at the alliances' bases inside the Imperial City Sewers. He is originally from Cheydinhal, but fled when the Imperial Legion came into town to forcefully enlist the townsfolk, which sparked a conflict between the two parties.
Donniel is a Bosmer residing in the town of Willowgrove, Reaper's March.
Dorzara is a character residing in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Dorianne Stelanie is a character residing in the Hubalajad Palace in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Dorathil is a Bosmer found on the island of Stirk during the moot of the three alliances.
Dore Ulanie is a Breton that was aboard one of the ships from Daggerfall that crashed at on the coast of Wrothgar while on their way to Orsinium.
Dovesi Terandas is a Dunmer commoner residing in Bleakrock Village. She has no unique dialogue.
Dovres Velni is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed in Fort Arand.
Dovres Rethelas is a Dunmer pilgrim residing outside the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City. He offers no unique dialogue.
Dovyn Trandel is a Dunmer residing in Suran. He is the tavern keeper of Desele's House of Earthly Delights.
Dortabi is a Khajiit servant in the Saint Delyn Plaza on the upper level of the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City.
Dondrinir is a Bosmer laborer found at the bridge east of Marandus. She cannot be interacted with.
Donthengeval is a Bosmer residing in Balmora, in Vvardenfell.
Dori Ernele is a Breton residing in Balmora, in Vvardenfell.
Dorisa Githendas is a Dunmer drunkard residing in Balmora, in the region of Vvardenfell.
Dominion Infantry is a generic Infantry character residing in .
Dovor Ralren is a Dunmer outlaw residing in Bramblebreach in the region of Greenshade, Valenwood. He is drunk most of the time.

The Dragonguard Archer is a generic character residing in the Tomb of the Dragonguard in Sancre Tor. This enemy is raised by Mannimarco to spit upon Sai Sahan's pride during the quest "Shadow of Sancre Tor."

The Dragonguard Assassin is a generic character residing in the Tomb of the Dragonguard in Sancre Tor. This enemy is raised by Mannimarco to spit upon Sai Sahan's pride during the quest "Shadow of Sancre Tor."

The Dragonguard Soldier is a generic character residing in the Tomb of the Dragonguard in Sancre Tor. This enemy is raised by Mannimarco to spit upon Sai Sahan's pride during the quest "Shadow of Sancre Tor."
Dorkrivva is a Khajiit residing in Mother's Den, a sublocation of the Shimmerene Waterworks underneath the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.

Dorharai is a Khajiit standing in front of a cooking fire on a hidden overlook of the west part of the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. The overlook is accessible by following the balcony from the Mages Guild. She has no unique dialogue.
Dradeiva is an Argonian residing near Tsofeer Cavern, who is focused on the downfall of the Ninth Legion. Her journal can be found just outside the Tsofeer Caverns.

Dragonguard Orland is a Imperial found at the Dov-Vahl Shrine in Northern Elsweyr. He is one of the last Dragonguard and his ring holds the key to the Dov-Vahl Sanctuary. He falls to Captain Saulinia's squad of assassins and holds on to life just long enough to give his ring to the Vestige. After he passes away, Zamarak says a prayer for him.
Domitiana Vitellis is a Imperial member of the Rimmen Fighters Guild in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr.
Doragren the Lacerator is a Xivkyn in . She may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She primarily uses melee attacks.
Dosu-Zeeus is a Argonian residing in Dusktown in Blackreach.
Draren Thiralas is a Dunmer commoner who lives in Seyda Neen.
Drelse Dralor is a Dunmer Noble and member of House Redoran residing in the Vivec, Redoran Canton. He can be found in the Lower Vault of Redoran Treasury.
Drarus Berano is a Dunmer Assassin who lives in Gnaar Mok, Morrowind. He is a member of House Hlaalu.

Drelasa Ramothran is a Dunmer who resides in Pelagiad, Morrowind. She is the publican at the Halfway Tavern, and has positive relations with the Thieves Guild members who frequent the establishment. She sells food and drinks to patrons, as well as renting beds to weary travelers.

Dralas Gilu is a Dunmer rogue who resides in Pelagiad, Morrowind. He is a Sixth House Cult sleeper agent being influenced by Dagoth Ur. Dralas can be found wandering the town near his home, equipped with an Iron Tanto and Crying Ring that blinds opponents should anything go awry. Although the door to his house is locked, he does not carry a key.

Dram is a Dunmer assassin during the Second Era. He is an ally of Tiber Septim and the Septim Empire and served under the orders of Amiel Richton on Stros M'kai. His enemies are Cyrus and the Crowns. He was born in Morrowind (technically not an Imperial Province yet) and was 252 (current incarnation 64, materialized CE612) at the time of the events of .
Dranas Sarathram is a Dunmer slaver located at the Suran Slave Market. As a part of his business, he is one of the few non-Argonians who speak the Argonian language.
Dredhwen is a Bosmer publican who runs The Wastrel's Purse in Passwall, which she found abandoned. For unknown reasons, she is always tired.
Dredena Hlavel is a Dunmer scout and adorer located at the Shrine of Mephala together with other worshippers of the Daedric Prince Mephala.
Dreet-Lai is an Argonian assassin and fugitive who is hiding in Bloodmayne Cave. He is a criminal who broke out of the Bravil prison with Hlofgar, Ashanta, and Enrion.
Drarayne Thelas is a Dunmer Commoner who lives in her in home in Balmora, on the east bank of the Odai River. She seems to have an obsession with pillows, as her home has quite an abundance of them.
Drahff is a small-time Nord bandit found in The Ratways with his accomplice Hewnon Black-Skeever.
